_notes.purpose: Schema definition for data/campaign_state.json. This file is a reference template — field values here are type descriptors, not live data.
_notes.campaign_state_file: data/campaign_state.json — created by bot when a campaign starts, updated each beat, archived on campaign end.
_notes.nullability: Fields marked 'null until set' will be null in the live file until that phase or action occurs.
_notes.ids: Discord snowflake IDs stored as strings to avoid 64-bit integer precision loss in JSON.
_notes.pressure: Only nodes with pressure > 0 are stored in the pressure dict. Missing key = pressure 0.
_notes.companies_and_kts: Keyed by Discord role ID string of the Watch Captain / Watch Sergeant respectively. One state entry per active company/KT.
_notes.cascade_submissions: Each role submits once per beat. Submission = { option_key, submitted_by (user_id), submitted_at }. Specialists and floating dreads submit a boolean present flag; their strats are auto-contributed from rank_mappings.json.
_notes.vacant: Vacant role = no submission entry in cascade_submissions for that role slot. Cascade passes through as per vacant rules in campaign_system.md.
_notes.strat_pool_locked: True once all KT-tier windows close or ceiling reached. Pool is fixed for entire ops window.
_notes.prestige_window: 28-day rolling window. Bot prunes entries older than 28 days on each beat evaluation.

campaign.phase: string — one of: cascade_HC | cascade_Company | cascade_KT | ops | evaluating | complete
campaign.ended_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp | null until complete
campaign.outcome: null until complete — one of: Full Victory | Costly Victory | Heroic Defeat | Efficient Victory | Holding Action | Last Stand | Lucky Hold | Neglected Front | Rout
visited_nodes: list of node id strings visited this campaign, in order
beat_history: list of beat_record objects, one per completed beat — see beat_record schema below

pressure._note: Dict of node_id → pressure int. Only non-zero nodes stored. Max meaningful value: 10+ = forced.

cascade._note: Current beat's cascade state. Reset each beat when cascade phase opens.
cascade.beat: int — which beat this cascade belongs to

HC._window_closed_at: ISO timestamp | null — null until tier advances

options_presented: list of node id strings presented to WM
traversal.chosen_node: string node id | null until submitted

theatre_order.option_key: string — named option key from cascade_options.json | null until submitted

Lord Executioner.option_key: string — named execution option | null until submitted

Forgemaster.present: bool — submitted their cascade participation flag
Forgemaster.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted

Chief Apothecary.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted

High Chaplain.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted

Huntmaster.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted
Huntmaster.terminus_flag: string — terminus target name flagged for the beat | null

Void Warden.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted

Castellan.option_key: string — named specialist angle | null until submitted
Castellan.log_text: string — Castellan's written narrative reasoning | null

Venerable Dreadnought.present: bool — floating, does not gate cascade advance
Venerable Dreadnought.option_key: string — named dread angle | null until submitted

Company._note: One entry per active company, keyed by Watch Captain discord user id string.

Watch Captain.option_key: string — named company order | null until submitted

Watch Lieutenant.option_key: string — named directive | null until submitted

Company Champion.option_key: string — named execution option | null until submitted

KT._note: One entry per active KT, keyed by Watch Sergeant discord user id string.

oathsworn_votes._note: Advisory votes cast before Sgt locks. Dict of user_id → option_key.

Watch Sergeant.option_key: string — locked doctrine | null until submitted
Watch Sergeant.required_strat: string — stratagem name locked as required for this KT's ops | null

Kill Team Champion.mission_id: int — specific mission picked | null until submitted
Kill Team Champion.terminus_call: string — terminus target name called for engagement | null

enlisted._note: All enlisted members of this KT who submitted a personal focus pick. Keyed by discord user id string.

USER_ID.rank: string — Watch Veteran | Watch Brother | Oathsworn
USER_ID.option_key: string — personal focus option | null until submitted

strat_pool._note: Locked stratagem pool for the ops window. Null until cascade KT window closes. Fixed for entire ops window.
strat_pool.locked: bool — false during cascade, true once ops window opens

required_by_kt._note: Per-KT required stratagem. Keyed by Sgt discord user id string.

prestige_missions._note: Per-KT prestige mission. Keyed by Sgt user id string.

ops_window.terminus_flag: string — Huntmaster's flagged target for the beat | null

terminus_calls._note: All engagement calls made during cascade. Keyed by role name.

prestige._note: 28-day rolling window. Pruned on each beat evaluation. Keyed by company/KT role id string.

COMPANY_ROLE_ID.total: int — current prestige total within window
COMPANY_ROLE_ID.tier: string — Unrecorded | Marked | Recognized | Honored | Exalted | Storied

KT_SGT_USER_ID.tier: string — Unproven | Initiated | Vigilant | Sworn | Hallowed | Eternal

beat_record._note: Archived per beat in campaign.beat_history once ops window closes and bot evaluates.
beat_record.node: string — node id committed this beat
beat_record.theatre_order: string — WM's theatre order option key

pressure_delta._note: Per-node pressure change this beat. Positive = increased, negative = reduced.

beat_record.ops_run: int — total ops submitted this beat

terminus_kills.prestige: int — terminus kills that qualified as prestige
terminus_kills.regular: int — terminus kills that did not qualify

strat_pool_snapshot: list of stratagem name strings used this beat
beat_record.chronicle_entry: string — bot-generated narrative paragraph for this beat | null
beat_record.castellan_log: string — Castellan's written reasoning logged this beat | null
